children: According to Sina Finance, U.S. officials said on the 2nd that the U.S.-Ukraine joint reconstruction investment fund has completed its first critical minerals deal and launched four additional new projects. Connor Coleman, investment chief at the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation, said the first minerals deal will inject about $30 million into BGV Group's "joint investment platform." The platform will initially focus on early-stage mining projects across Ukraine, targeting rare earths, uranium, beryllium, and zirconium, which Coleman said are all on the U.S. critical minerals list.

title: U.S.-Ukraine Reconstruction Fund Finalizes First Critical Minerals Deal
